66.artist_bio: TREY CHOPS is back and better than ever after a 5-year hiatus, and he’s ready to release the music you’ve all been waiting for.If you’re sick and tired of music that lacks culture, lyrics, and just sounds good all-around, CHOPS has something that you’re going to enjoy.With melodic riffs and hard-hitting drums, TREY CHOPS is a producer, songwriter, and recording artist from Ontario, Canada.All of his music is entirely self-produced, and will continue to be into the foreseeable future.

159.artist_bio: sKitz Kraven is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter from Sun Prairie, Wisconsin currently living in Los Angeles, California. With a horrorcore aesthetic and a versatile catalog, sKitz Kraven is making a large impact in the underground hip hop scene and is best known for his singles “Magic” and “That’s All”. Kraven has gained a cult following and a worldwide fan base with his dark sound, intense rhyme scheme, and “in your face” delivery.

229.artist_bio: Dalemonte Stilley, better known by his stage names RX Hector or DrugRixh Hect, is a rapper from Atlanta, Georgia. He is a member of the MONY POWR RSPT (Money Power Respect) movement led by fellow rapper Hoodrich Pablo Juan and is a frequent collaborator of Hoodrich Pablo Juan, DrugRixh Pe$o, DrugRixh Scarfo da Plug, and Lil Dude.RX Hector and two accomplices were accused of stealing a man’s iPhone in a November 2015 incident. In September 2017, after pleading guilty to aggravated assault with intent to rob and robbery, he was sentenced to five years, with the first two years to be in prison.So far, he has released two mixtapes: 2016’s Ian Never Had Shit and 2017’s Hector, Vol. 1. A sequel to the latter mixtape, Hector, Vol. 2, is expected for a 2018 release.
